composition_label: Structured extraction -> Behavioral personalization -> Knowledge-base answers

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.definition: implementation.py SCHEMAS, validated by check() and validate()
shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version, fixture_label, document, fields, as_of, items, events, knowledge_base, config. Unknown keys rejected. All example data synthetic.
shared_schema.fields: Mapping from field names to label/type/required. Types: string or number. customer_id/category/question must be declared string fields; additional fields are supported.
shared_schema.output: One status=ok JSON envelope: schema_version, extraction, behavior, faq. Error envelope: status=error and error; exit 2.
shared_schema.extraction: Every declared field maps to null or value/raw/span. Spans are half-open Unicode character offsets. Sorted missing_fields and missing_required.
shared_schema.behavior: Validated extracted context, cold_start, matched_events, ranked recommendations with component scores.
shared_schema.faq: status=answered or abstained, question, category, answer, citation, retrieval_score, reason.
shared_schema.constraints: Strict booleans, finite numbers, nonblank identifiers, positive half-life and integer top_k, threshold in [0,1], timezone-aware ISO timestamps, no future events, unique catalog/KB IDs, known event item references.

cross_stage_handoffs: extract -> behavior: validate extracted types, source spans, raw/value equivalence and missing reports; customer_id selects events, category supplies interest prior, question passes into context.

behavior -> faq: validate ranking types/order/score components and cold-start state; the highest-ranked item category filters knowledge retrieval, and validated context supplies the extracted question.
faq -> output: validate exact answer/citation text against a category-matching KB article; validate shared final output envelope.

behavior.extraction: Case-insensitive escaped label followed by colon at line start; whitespace trimmed while preserving exact source offsets. Missing/blank fields reported without stopping downstream stages. Repeated labels and invalid numeric values are errors.
behavior.ranking: Sum purchase=3 and browse=1 times 0.5 ** (age_days / half_life_days), plus 0.5 for exact extracted category match. Events from other customers excluded. Score ties broken by item ID.
behavior.cold_start: No matching customer events: category preference then stable item-ID fallback. No customer ID never matches events. Empty catalog leads to FAQ abstention.
behavior.retrieval: Category restricted to top recommendation. Score is fraction of normalized non-stopword query tokens present in article question. Highest score wins, article-ID tie-break. Positive score meeting inclusive faq_min_score required.
behavior.grounding: Answer is copied verbatim from one selected KB article, with article ID and exact quote. No generated claims.
behavior.abstention: missing_question, no_recommendations, or insufficient_evidence; null answer and citation.
behavior.determinism: Explicit as_of, stable ties, no system clock, random state, network, model calls or mutable global pipeline state.

included: One integrated offline CLI pipeline and shared validation layer
Schema-driven line-field extraction and numeric coercion
Recency-weighted personalized ranking with cold-start handling
Grounded lexical knowledge retrieval and explicit abstention
Synthetic fixtures, in-process handoff validation and subprocess CLI tests
excluded: OCR, PDF parsing and arbitrary free-form semantic extraction
Live providers, LLM generation or injected model callables
Embeddings, synonym inference and learned personalization
Authentication, storage, event deduplication and enterprise deployment
Catalog availability filtering and multi-article answer synthesis

example_cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status=ok
